display_name: 已知信道后的高斯收缩与噪声残留对照
description: 保持真实模拟算子、真实噪声标量和原先验，用同一增益分别消除实际噪声项和高斯收缩项。

data.version: Original392005 source contract; existing R07 fixed1800 V/7 frozen validation views
data.representation: Original source V480 ×7 clean/observed R07 IQ, known simulator h/m/i and scalar noise. No regenerated inputs.
data.tx_sets_ref: Original six known sourceTX; V trueTX validation only, no train/selection
data.actual_training_labels: None. Original L_s2 real model smoke, then V frozen diagnostic only.
data.augmentation: Reuse all seven original source V observations, no regenerated signals.

permissions.query_use: Known simulator factors and source clean IQ used only for source diagnostic counterfactual. No target/OE/novel/train.
permissions.claim_scope: Conditional on one fixed linear inverse. Measures additive IQ effects and nonlinear frozen TX responses. No theoretical bound or deployment claim.

checkpoint.initialization: Original BF frozen prior buffers and original F0 default head. No G estimator or new checkpoint.
sources: DATA_ONLY original R07 source V480×7 and original L_s2 smoke
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original validated source handles, exact V IDs and clean F0 references.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen same-source BF and F0. No G training, target or OE/novel/TX access.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Same 3 interventions ×7 fixed. No source or target fit or selection.

metric_names: Paired true TX repairs/damage and clean-correct retention for each counterfactual, same seven scenes
Exact relative noise leakage, shrinkage NMSE and cross term with identity check; original known-output consistency.
dimensions: three fresh frozen readouts plus reused raw clean

rows.purpose: Distinguish actual noise leakage from prior shrinkage under the same true channel.
rows.seed_notes: Fixed original record order and original F0; no new RNG or phase selection.
rows.scenario: Original source V480 x7, five inference-only readouts.

notes: Original observed posterior = raw clean - shrinkage + filtered realized noise. True variance stays fixed in the gain.
Noise removed substitutes noiseless received IQ without lowering regularization. Shrinkage removed uses true clean + original filtered noise.
Both need exact clean and simulator factors and are source-only counterfactuals. No new deployment candidate, no effect on Main scheduling.
